title: Installation: Windows & macOS | Amigo — AI Career Companion & Interview Copilot
description: Step-by-step installation of the Amigo desktop copilot on Windows 10/11 and macOS 12+. System requirements, download links, and first-run setup.
html:
Amigo is a lightweight desktop application. Installation takes under 2 minutes on either Windows or macOS.

System Requirements

WindowsmacOS
OS VersionWindows 10 / 11 (64-bit)macOS 12 Monterey or later
RAM4 GB minimum (8 GB recommended)4 GB minimum (8 GB recommended)
Storage200 MB free200 MB free
InternetRequired for AI featuresRequired for AI features
MicrophoneRequiredRequired

Installing on Windows

  1. Download the installer from your Amigo dashboard or directly from amigohelp.ai.
  2. Run the helpamigo.exe installer.
  3. Follow the installation wizard and click Install.
  4. Amigo will launch automatically after installation. Sign in with your Amigo account, the same email and password you use on the web app.

Windows SmartScreen may show a security prompt on first launch. Click More info → Run anyway to proceed. Amigo is signed and verified software.

Some antivirus programs (e.g. Windows Defender, Malwarebytes) may flag or quarantine helpamigo.exe on first run. This is a false positive. Amigo does not collect or transmit personal data beyond what is required for AI features. If this happens, add helpamigo.exe to your antivirus exclusion list and re-run the installer.

Installing on macOS

  1. Download the helpamigo.dmg file from your dashboard.
  2. Open the DMG and drag the Amigo app into your Applications folder.
  3. On first launch, macOS will prompt for Microphone, Accessibility, and Screen Recording permissions; grant all three.
  4. Sign in with your Amigo account, the same email and password you use on the web app. Amigo will run a system readiness check before starting your session.

Required Permissions

Amigo requires the following system permissions to function correctly:
